name: Securities Account Activity Advice V 01
definition: The SecuritieAccountActivityReport message is sent by the executing party to an instructing party containing information about changes on securities account reference data.||Scope and usage: |It aims at informing about the changes occurred during a business date for securities account reference data.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message (within a statement) and continuation indicator to indicate that the statement is to continue or that the message is the last page of the statement.

SecuritiesAccountActivity.name: Securities Account Activity
SecuritiesAccountActivity.definition: Activity report of changes occurred for a specific securities account defined in the system.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
